name: qr-cow-browser-extension
description: qr-cow browser extension (Firefox + Chrome) — generate styled QR codes from any page, link, selection, or typed content. Fully offline.

scripts.package: npm run build && npm run lint && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts/firefox --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts/chrome --overwrite-dest
